name: Open Day
text: I shared the insect VR experiment at NCBS Open Day. A projection let visitors follow the virtual landscape while we explored how insects use airflow and odour.

media.alt: Visitors gather around two monitors while a large projection shows a virtual sky and grassy landscape.
media.label: At NCBS Open Day in 2016, the virtual landscape was projected so visitors could follow the experiment.

name: Moth Day
text: Visitors tried an odour-sampling station and explored how insects sense their surroundings.

media.alt: A visitor leans toward clear tubes connected to small bottles at an outdoor odour station.
media.label: At NCBS Moth Day in 2018, visitors could try an odour-sampling setup alongside the insect demonstrations.

name: Non Flowers at the V&A
place: FOOD: Bigger than the Plate · London
text: Our NICE Lab collaboration with Thomas Pausz and Srishti artists explored the flower cues pollinators use. The resulting Non Flowers models were shown in FOOD: Bigger than the Plate at the V&A in 2019.

media.alt: An open exhibition catalogue shows Non Flower for a Hoverfly, with photographs of flower-like models and an insect in a virtual scene.
media.label: The exhibition catalogue for FOOD: Bigger than the Plate, at the V&A in 2019. Non Flower for a Hoverfly is credited to Thomas Pausz and Shannon Olsson.
media.credit: Photo: Pavan · CC BY-SA 4.0. Work pictured: Thomas Pausz and Shannon Olsson; NICE Lab and Srishti collaboration.

name: Umwelt: A nocturnal animal gathering
text: I took the insect VR setup to KULA for an evening of art, science, robotics and music, with other scientists and artists.

media.alt: An insect VR rig and tracking monitor overlook a purple-lit room with visitors below.
media.label: I took the insect VR setup to KULA for Umwelt, an evening of art, science and music in Konstanz in 2023.

gallery.alt: A visitor leans over the insect VR rig, with its ball-tracking display in the foreground and stage lights behind.
gallery.label: A visitor takes a closer look at the setup during Umwelt.

name: Long Night of Museums
text: Visitors could turn the ball and watch the virtual scene respond, seeing how a movement becomes part of the experiment.

media.alt: Visitors watch a laptop showing a virtual world beside an LED-panel rig; a panel behind it describes locust swarms.
media.label: I took the rig to Munich’s Long Night of Museums in 2025. Visitors could turn the ball and watch the virtual scene respond.
